name: recommended
title: Default NVIDIA block-FP8 profile
supported_hardware: Architecture-compatible with NVIDIA CUDA GPUs at compute capability >= 8.0 (Ampere or newer); sufficient VRAM required
disclosure: Default NVIDIA SM80+ single-request release, benchmarked on an RTX 3060 12 GB. That GPU measured 248.52 decode tok/s, 1.503x its matched BF16 vLLM reference. HumanEval+ scored 96/164 versus 95/164; the frozen 200-task cross-domain suite scored 87/200 versus 89/200. Other GPUs are compatible but unbenchmarked, and FP8 changes outputs.
